question: Should this release remove the shipped bundled skills and make Sherpa ONNX TTS an official ClawHub-only plugin under the proposed migration and trust contract?
rationale: The change intentionally alters shipped capability availability, upgrade behavior, official install trust, dependency resolution, and native artifact handling; tests cannot determine the desired compatibility policy.

options.title: Stage migration before removal
options.body: Publish and verify every replacement, add doctor migration for shipped references and settings, and approve exact-head dependency and artifact trust before landing.

options.title: Split Sherpa packaging
options.body: Land the Sherpa external plugin and install-routing work separately while retaining the current bundled starter set.

options.title: Park the broad trim
options.body: Keep the shipped bundles until release owners have a complete deprecation and support plan.

recommendation.title: Stage migration before removal
recommendation.body: Publish and verify every replacement, add doctor migration for shipped references and settings, and approve exact-head dependency and artifact trust before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the merged split work and explicitly defined this PR as the remaining bundled-skill and Sherpa product decision surface.
